editorial.blurb: Mizu Sushi delivers fresh, properly prepared sushi with genuine warmth from a staff that goes the extra mile.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about cooked sushi options if you're pregnant or prefer them—the staff is exceptionally accommodating. Try the sushi deluxe to experience their best fish work.

topDishes.note: Fresh fish with distinct textures and generous portions, served at the ideal temperature
